name: sendnaro
description: Sendnaro monorepo — quotes, invoices, receipts, payments and WhatsApp delivery for freelancers and small businesses.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@sendnaro/api & npm run dev --workspace=@sendnaro/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@sendnaro/shared && npm run build --workspace=@sendnaro/ui && npm run build --workspace=@sendnaro/database && npm run build --workspace=@sendnaro/api && npm run build --workspace=@sendnaro/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=@sendnaro/shared && npm run build --workspace=@sendnaro/database && npm run build --workspace=@sendnaro/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@sendnaro/shared && npm run build --workspace=@sendnaro/ui && npm run build --workspace=@sendnaro/web
